label: GO step after an unrewarded trial, early in the episode (first ~40-50 trials)
explanation: Fires only at GO (100% of mass; never at D1 or D2). 97% of mass falls on GOs whose D1 showed no reward (prev_reward == 0). It also depends strongly on how far into the episode the trial is: rate is about 33% on trial 0, 12% on trials 0-9, falls steadily to about 2% by trials 40-49, and it is essentially silent after trial ~55. So it reads as an unrewarded-GO signal that decays over the episode. Uses only observed variables. Phase + prev_reward alone gets F1 0.35 (recall 0.93, precision 0.22). Adding ep_trial < 40 raises dev F1 to 0.64 (P 0.52, R 0.83, mass recall 0.94); ep_trial < 50 gives F1 0.60 with mass recall 0.97. Missed activations are weak (6% of mass): GOs after a reward that follow earlier losses, or just past the trial cutoff. The largest activations come in runs of consecutive unrewarded trials early in the episode, but requiring two losses in a row hurts recall (F1 0.46). Many unrewarded early GOs stay silent, so precision is incomplete. The model value at these steps is mid-to-high (7.5-8.1), and the choice logit is strongly to one side (|choice| > 4), not undecided. The unit is not selective for choice, reached state, transition, or the hidden good state.
